preconditions.description: The length of the good letters string must be between 1 and 26.
The length of the pattern string must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of query strings must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in good_letters)
preconditions.description: All characters in the good letters string must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for c in pattern)
preconditions.description: The pattern must consist of lowercase English letters, '?', and '*'.

preconditions.expression: sum(1 for c in pattern if c == '*') <= 1
preconditions.description: The pattern must contain at most one '*' character.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(query) <= 100000 for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string must be non-empty and have a length not exceeding 100,000.
The total length of all query strings must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: For each query string, output 'YES' if it matches the pattern, otherwise output 'NO'.
The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each query string.
